name: 05-post-without-field-param-is-caught
description: Without a 'field' form parameter, payload.field is null and payload.field.isEmpty() fails while the query is being built, so Salesforce is never called (no downstream request at all) and the catch-exception-strategy answers 'Invalid Salesforce query.'.

source.reference: salesforce-data-retrieval/src/main/app/salesforce-id-retrieval.xml (flow salesforceDataRetrievalFlow: sfdc:query-all with the MEL query, foreach byte-array-to-string + 'flowVars.response + payload', set-payload #[response], byte-array-to-string, catch-exception-strategy 'Invalid Salesforce query.')
